core_obstacle: The accepted results establish scoped task utility and sensitivity to weighting interventions, but supply no independent property of the joint frozen representations, roles and labels that explains why this particular circuit-constrained score family should learn useful relations. Per-label queries, pooling and separate decoders already occur in the scoped CAML/LAAT originals. A nonlinear label-wise attention mechanism, circuit-restricted inductive bias and differences in learning can all remain compatible with the packet. Architectural description alone selects none of them. The missing premise is task-dependent and distinguishable from simply assuming Q-realizability.

nontrivial_result_required: A future route would need an independently specified task/learning premise and a conclusion about the actual normalized attention-plus-value classifier that distinguishes it from the known label-wise mechanism. It must state whether its target is population surrogate risk, hard multiclass decisions or Macro-F1, rather than move between them. No such premise or result is supported in this packet. A generic capacity bound or an assumption that the desired Q predictor is optimal would not fill the gap.
discriminating_prediction: None is licensed for a new route. The Q-versus-uniform Macro-F1 result and the fixed-head shuffled-weight CE penalty concern different interventions and metrics; jointly they do not predict superiority over a specified nonlinear label-wise control or identify a circuit-specific learning effect. The five-seed inferential qualifications remain unchanged.
smallest_next_action: One bounded source/proof gate, with no training or forwards: select at most one original learning-theory source that explicitly claims a task-dependent benefit of label-wise attention under fixed globally contextual features. Extract its precise assumption on the joint distribution of features, roles and labels, then check by derivation whether the existing approved evidence actually entails it; a counterexample consistent with that evidence is sufficient to reject transfer. The existence of such a matching source is presently unknown. If no non-tautological task premise survives this check, retain the stop rather than commission another generic bound or rename an existing architecture. This is an evidence gate, not a supported new research method.
kill_gate: Do not promote this theory line if its premise is only Q-realizability, generic smoothness/capacity, per-label pooling, or a raw-input locality assumption invalidated by the global frozen encoder. Also stop if the claimed conclusion is already a known label-wise result, depends on unverified matched-control outcomes, or transfers CE statements directly to hard decisions or empirical Macro-F1. No further action on a closed family is justified by this advice.
